purpose: Bounded risk-control experiment for the leading ENA 1h Bollinger/RSI mean-reversion development hypothesis. It does not alter price-strategy-tournament-v1.1 and cannot establish out-of-sample profitability.

signal.timing: signal on completed candle, execute desired position at next candle open
signal.selection_note: Chosen as the leading ENA-specific development hypothesis after the broad tournament. This is an inspected development choice, not preregistered OOS evidence.

risk_trials.after_stop_or_target: remain flat until original signal state resets or reverses

development_gate.selection_rule: The 1.5 ATR reference is judged as a risk-control hypothesis, not selected by maximum PF or maximum return.

forward_rule.if_reference_passes: freeze exact signal, risk, cost and timing specification before consuming later observations
